summary: Card Library Owned editor: Tab accepts the number and opens the next card's field (right, else first of the next row) with its value highlighted; Shift+Tab accepts and opens the previous card (left, else last of the row above). The list's ends stop.
validation: Client builds; native MyCollectionProbe with real key events: 48 assertions pass (5 new: Tab, highlight, Shift+Tab, row wrap forward and back); dotnet format clean.
remaining: Tab at the very last or first card only accepts. Not hand-tested beyond the native probe.
